title: Binance Futures DEFI Composite Index Will Be Rebalanced (2025-04-16)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Following the  delisting of BAL on Binance Spot ,  Binance Futures will rebalance the DEFI Composite Index by removing  BAL  from the components from  2025-04-16 02:00 (UTC) . In addition, Binance Futures will add ENA as one of the DEFI Composite Index components from  2025-04-16 02:00 (UTC) . Notes: Users can find the latest components and weightage information  here .   API users may use  GET /fapi/v1/indexInfo  to find the latest components and weightage information. For further details and updates, please refer to our full  API Changelog . For More Information: About DEFI Composite Index Note : There may be discrepancies between this original announcement in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-15
